title: RADIHALT Phone SAR Dataset
description: RADIHALT Research publishes this open, reviewed snapshot to make U.S. phone SAR data easier to compare, verify, cite, and reuse. It includes FCC 1-gram head and body Specific Absorption Rate values for 28 selected Apple, Samsung, and Google phones released from 2020 through 2024, with model, release year, FCC ID, and a permanent RADIHALT detail-page URL. The included methodology defines the dataset's scope; it is not a live catalog or a prediction of typical exposure or health risk.
